Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com

We are seeking a Market Research Analyst to contribute to our next level of growth and expansion.



Job Description

The Details:

  • Duration: 12-month contract
  • Location: Remote (Preferred location: New York, NY; Little Falls, NJ; DC Metro area; and Houston, TX. Also: Samford, CT; NC, and FL.)
  • Benefits: We offer benefits to our full-time consultants, including Health, Vision, Dental, 401K plan, Life Insurance, Pretax Commuter Benefits, and an incredibly supportive team cheering you on!

Job Description

  • Support implementation and analysis of the clientâs quantitative research projects.
  • Support the development of the questionnaires, polls, and other research instruments.
  • Support analysis of the data gathered via quantitative or multi-source data and research
  • Program and deploy surveys and polls in Qualtrics
  • Pull the target list for research deployment from various sources/systems
  • Create cross-tabs and verbatim files
  • Append data and customer information
  • Assist in writing and editing reports and presentations for stakeholders.
  • Undertake curation of the Market Intelligence repository of research reports and related materials.
  • Lead tracking of the research projects across the enterprise.
  • Support expansion of the VoC and VoE programs, including future integration with Salesforce, API, etc.
  • Additional responsibilities will include maintaining and over-time managing the clients' Customer Panel.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three (3) years of experience in market research or a related function
  • Prior experience in programming and deploying surveys using Qualtrics or Medallia, or a similar survey utility.
  • Expert knowledge of Excel, VLOOKUP, and Pivot tables.
  • Familiarity with PowerPoint functionalities, including reporting, animations, transitions, and multimedia integration.
  • Demonstrated analytic and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Willingness to learn additional software used (e.g., Cvent for uploading conference lists)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively multitask.

Additional Information

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, paid holidays, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.



A diverse workforce is a strong workforce To deliver growth at BLEND360 and for our clients, we believe we have a responsibility and unique opportunity to positively impact the workforce. Diversity has played a critical role in our history, our growth, and continues to have a profound impact on our success. We are determined to have equality in the workplace, within our team and as an extension of our clientsâ team.

This is not the work of the moment, and this requires continued learning and purposeful actions. We are investing resources to understand and improve the sourcing, selection, and retention of the talent we hire, and ultimately the workforce we provide for our clients. We will communicate our journey in the spirit of transparency and shared learning.

title: Social Media and Video Content Manager
description:
About Ajaia

Ajaia is a fast-growing AI consultancy and product studio that helps organizations move from experimentation to real results. We work across AI Strategy, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Enablement, and Custom Product Development, and we build our own AI products alongside client work.

Our mission is to help organizations win the AI moment.

About The Role

You will own content execution across social, short and long-form video, podcast workflows, and training video.

You own the calendar, the output, and the numbers. You write platform-native content for LinkedIn, X, and email. You edit video people actually finish watching. You build the AI-assisted workflows that make all of it faster without making it generic.

This role is AI-forward by design. You will use AI daily for ideation, scripting, editing, repurposing, and QA. We expect you to already work this way.

What You Will Do

  • Own social content operations from planning to publishing to performance reporting
  • Write platform-native content for LinkedIn, X, and email newsletters
  • Edit short and long-form video for marketing and thought leadership
  • Run podcast post-production, clips, and distribution
  • Produce and edit training video for internal and client-facing use
  • Build reusable AI-assisted workflows for scripting, editing, and repurposing
  • Hold the line on brand voice and quality across every output

Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years in social content, video editing, or multi-channel content management
  • Demonstrated ownership of publishing workflows and deadlines
  • Strong writing for LinkedIn, X, and email newsletter formats
  • Experience editing training or educational video
  • Evidence of AI-native execution in daily content work
  • Strong written communication and async habits on a remote team

Portfolio, required. Applications without samples will not be reviewed: LinkedIn, X, email newsletter, and video editing samples covering both short and long-form.

Schedule. Fully remote, with required overlap 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

Technical. Wired internet 100 Mbps minimum. Intel Core i7, Ryzen 7, or Apple Silicon with 16GB RAM and 256GB free storage. Windows 11 or current macOS. 1080p webcam and mic. Backup power and internet.

Process. Application and portfolio review, two-hour practical assessment, hiring manager interview, final conversation with leadership.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary plus performance incentives
  • Performance bonus up to 100 percent of base
  • Fully remote with earned flexibility
  • Professional development budget
  • Paid time off

Why join Ajaia

You will own a broad content function spanning social, video, podcast, and training, not one narrow slice of it. You will build thought leadership at a company doing AI implementation work that reaches production, and design scalable content systems rather than grinding out one-off assets.

Let's build what's next.

title: Executive Assistant & Administrative Manager
description:
Headquarters: NYC
URL: http://blankcanvasmarketing.com

Executive Assistant

Remote | Eastern European Working Hours

Blank Canvas Marketing is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to become the organizational backbone of our company.

We're a fast-moving marketing agency filled with creative thinkers. Creativity is our strength. Organization needs to be yours.

You'll be the person who keeps everything running behind the scenes—ensuring our finances, files, systems, and day-to-day operations stay organized and nothing slips through the cracks.

This role is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys creating order, loves supporting a team, and takes pride in being the person everyone can rely on.

Responsibilities

Finance & Administration

  • Prepare and send client invoices

  • Reconcile payments and company accounts

  • Maintain monthly bookkeeping records

  • Coordinate with our accountant and ensure financial records are organized and up to date

Operations

  • Maintain our client database (CRM)

  • Organize and maintain our file management systems

  • Keep internal documentation accurate and easy to find

  • Help ensure projects stay on track by following up on outstanding tasks and deadlines

  • Create and improve systems that keep the business running smoothly

Executive Support

From time to time, you'll also provide executive and personal assistant support to the CEO, including:

  • Managing calendars and booking appointments

  • Researching travel and coordinating itineraries

  • Finding contractors and service providers

  • Handling occasional administrative tasks in different countries (She is also location independent)

  • Assisting with miscellaneous projects as they arise

No two days are exactly the same. You will have a good mix of routine and novelty.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

  • Reliable, dependable, and someone people naturally trust

  • Proactive - you enjoy solving problems before they become problems

  • Calm under pressure and able to keep multiple priorities organized

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

  • Excellent in written and spoken English

  • Naturally curious and enjoys learning new technology

  • Fluent in bookkeeping and US accounting

You don't need to know every tool already, but you should be excited to learn. We're especially looking for someone who enjoys exploring how AI can safely and responsibly automate repetitive work and improve efficiency without sacrificing quality.

An interest in startups is a big plus. We primarily work with startups, so this is the space you will be surrounded by. 

Nice to Have

  • Experience as an Executive Assistant or Operations Assistant

  • Experience with CRMs and cloud-based productivity tools

  • Strong Google Workspace skills

  • Confidence learning new software quickly

  • יכול לדבר עברית

Working Hours

This is a fully remote position with working hours aligned to the Eastern European time zone. You don't need to be in our time zone, but at least 5 hours of your day should be able to overlap with ours.

About Blank Canvas Marketing

Blank Canvas Marketing is a full service marketing agency that helps growth stage startups scale.

We're looking for someone who takes genuine pride in helping others succeed. Someone who enjoys creating order from complexity, notices the details others miss, and wants to become a trusted, long-term member of a close-knit team.

If you're the type of person who loves checklists, color-coded folders, and the satisfaction of knowing everything is exactly where it should be, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply: Please send cover letter and resume to neighborhoodhosts@gmail.com with the title Executive Assistant

title: Salesforce & Omnichannel Data Analytics Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Headquarters: Cheshire
URL: http://bavarian-nordic.com

Salesforce & Omnichannel Data Analytics Lead (m/f/d)

Are you ready to take on a challenge where your expertise in data analytics, omnichannel performance, CRM, and digital campaigns can make a real impact?

Great!

We are looking for a Salesforce & Omnichannel Data Analytics Lead (m/f/d) to join our commercial team and help turn data into actionable insights.

This position offers a fully remote setup for candidates located in the UK.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Integrate, validate and analyze data from CRM, digital platforms and other sources to create a unified and actionable view of customer activities

  • Define, standardize and monitor KPIs across CRM and digital platforms to ensure transparency, alignment and action

  • Develop, automate and maintain omnichannel and sales force effectiveness dashboards, and deliver campaign and engagement performance metrics across brands and geographies to assess performance and identify improvement areas

  • Conduct ad-hoc deep dives and root cause analyses to support tactical decision-making and strategic planning across markets and products

  • Ensure data quality, consistency and structure across internal and external sources

  • Act as the senior point of contact for all analytics topics related to field force, digital and omnichannel performance

About you – your qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics or a related field

  • Proven experience in omnichannel engagement analytics, digital campaigns, CRM metrics, field force performance and social media data analysis

  • Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device industry is an advantage

  • Proficiency in reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI and working knowledge of Python for data analysis, automation and advanced analytics

  • Advanced knowledge of CRM systems such as Veeva and Salesforce as well as marketing platforms (Marketing Cloud) and Google Analytic

  • Strong understanding of database structures with the ability to integrate, extract, analyze and interpret data, build dashboards from scratch and automate scalable reporting

  • Fluency in English, German is a plus

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Caught your interest?

Join a passionate, mission-driven global biotech committed to protecting lives. At Bavarian Nordic, you’ll find a collaborative culture, flexible work environment, and opportunities for ongoing professional development and growth.

Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com

title: Sales Consultant, Hospital Solutions (Upstate NY)
description:
Headquarters: Syracuse, NY, USA
URL: http://freseniusmedicalcare.com

ADDENDUM:

Sales Consultant, Hospital Solutions

In addition to the responsibilities outlined in the core job description, the Sales Consultant, Hospital Solutions will:

  • Manage all new and existing accounts, identifies and closes new business opportunities, and delivers comprehensive solutions across the full product portfolio for both In Center and Hospital.

PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

This role is responsible for supporting sales growth and customer engagement driving sales performance, clinical support, and overall customer service within an assigned sales territory. The position manages new and existing accounts, provides product and clinical support, and identifies opportunities to expand utilization across the portfolio.  The role builds and maintains strong customer relationships, leads territory-level collaboration with internal partners, and ensures accurate use of sales tools, forecasting, and contract management.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage all new and existing accounts, identifies and closes new business opportunities, and delivers comprehensive solutions across the full product portfolio for both In Center and Hospital.
  • Own all accounts in assigned territory, new and existing account relationships, and represent the entire product portfolio for assigned modalities.
  • Identify and close new opportunities by developing appropriate solutions and delivering implementation support across all customer types
  • Manage and nurture account relationships to drive expansion and renewals, secure wallet share and demonstrate problem solving to customers as needs arise. 
  • Engages in regular face to face customer call activity.
  • Leads collaboration and coordination with all supporting roles to handle customer needs and expectations
  • Use FME sales tools daily to effectively manage prospects, existing accounts, opportunities, pipeline and forecast in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Maintain accurate and timely management of customer contracts, including pricing adjustments and system updates.
  • Identify market trends, threats, and opportunities using sales data and customer feedback, and develop strategic plans to improve performance and market share within assigned territory.
  • Build strong customer relationships by delivering value-driven solutions and providing exceptional follow-up and service to internal and external customers.
  • Support field activities, including equipment evaluations, in-services, technical demonstrations, and training, to ensure customer success.
  • Monitor and maintain customer market share, entering and closing customer appointments and capturing relevant sales campaign data.
  • Develop professional expertise and maintain technical and clinical proficiency across assigned modalities.
  • Attend local, regional, and national events, meetings, and training sessions to enhance product knowledge, market understanding, and professional growth.
  • Exercise good judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.
  • Reviews and complies with the Code of Business Conduct and all applicable company compliance policies and procedures, local, state and federal laws and regulations.
  • Assists with various projects as assigned by direct supervisor.
  • Completes all administrative duties as assigned by direct supervisor such as accurate and timely expense reports and operates within operating expense budget.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Additional responsibilities may include focus on one or more departments or locations.  See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Must be able to physically cover and maintain regular face-to-face contact with customers over a assigned geographic area.
  • Extensive travel by automobile/train/airplane is often necessary to cover assigned territory which includes overnight stays.
  • Contact with customers by phone alone is not adequate. Occasional weekend work is necessary to support trade show events.
  • Lifting requirements involve setting up portable booths, occasional lifting up to 50lbs, and transporting medical equipment and supplies for purposes of in-servicing customers.
  • Must reside within assigned territory.

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; advanced degree preferred or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2-5 years’ related medical sales experience.
  • Experience and proven success with consultative selling; approach and methodology
  • Demonstrates effective presentation skills, professional and executive presence, and effectively establishes credibility with any audience.
  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written; demonstrates ability to deliver timely and useful multi-mode communications to both internal and external customers.
  • Must have basic computer skills including but not necessarily limited to, Word, Excel, Power Point.

The rate of pay for this position will depend on the successful candidate’s work location and qualifications, including relevant education, work experience, skills, and competencies.

Base Salary: $95, 000 - $110, 000 (Plus Sales Incentives)

Benefit Overview: This position offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off, parental leave.
 

Fresenius Medical Care is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, parental status, national origin, age, disability, military service, or other non-merit-based factors

We take pride in offering a dynamic and inspiring workplace culture, where team members have the freedom to generate new ideas, learn continuously, and actively contribute to shaping the future of IoT. With a diverse and international team, Neoception thrives on collaboration and innovation. Let’s create something extraordinary together and join our team as:

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Cycle unserer Softwarelösung im industriellen Umfeld (von der Erstansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss)

  • Führung von Vertragsverhandlungen sowie eigenständiges Closing von Deals

  • Bestehendes Netzwerk und relevante Kontakte im industriellen (IT-)Umfeld
  • Gutes Verständnis für industrielle Digitalisierung / Industrie 4.0
  • Eigenständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Eigenmotivation sowie Freude am Aufbau neuer Märkte

Was wir bieten

  • Offene Unternehmenskultur mit direkter Kommunikation und kurzen Entscheidungswegen

September 2026** (späterer Einstieg möglich) Verstärkung im Online Marketing, die Lust hat, Ideen zum Leben zu erwecken – eigenständig, verantwortungsbewusst und mit echter Freude an starken Marketingprojekten. Du erkennst, was eine gute Geschichte ausmacht, entwickelst daraus Content-Ideen und bringst sie über digitale Kanäle, Websites, Newsletter und Social Media dorthin, wo sie Menschen erreichen. **Deine Aufgaben** - Content für unsere Themenwelten kreieren und über Social Media, Websites, Newsletter, Kampagnen sowie Bild- und Videoinhalte umsetzen - Kampagnen mitentwickeln und umsetzen - Websites und digitale Kanäle pflegen - Kleine grafische Arbeiten umsetzen - Dienstleister professionell briefen und steuern - Projekte eigenständig umsetzen - Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Team zusammen und stimmst strategische Themen regelmäßig ab **Unsere Erwartungen** - Du liebst deinen kreativen Job - hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Marketing und/oder mehrjährige Erfahrung im Marketing, Content Marketing oder in digitalen Medien - kannst Social Media und Storytelling - bist sehr erfahren in der inhaltlichen und gestalterischen Pflege von Websites - bringst professionelles Verständnis für Layout, Gestaltung und Markenauftritt mit - beherrschst SEO, digitale Tools und KI-Anwendungen - hast Lust Neues auszuprobieren und umzusetzen **Deine Vorteile** - Du arbeitest für handverlesene hochwertige Marken - bist umgeben von traumhaft schöner Natur - hast ein kleines Team, auf das Du immer vertrauen kannst - kannst flexible Arbeitszeiten nutzen - arbeitest mit modernem Equipment - Du erhältst 50 % Wochenend- sowie 100 % Feiertagszuschüsse, sollte der Job Wochenendarbeitszeit beinhalten - sicherst Dir zusätzliche Unterstützung durch unsere Erholungsbeihilfe - title: Home-Based Marketing Data Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Philippines
URL: http://delegatecx.com

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

GNumber of Openings: 1

Are you a detail-oriented marketing professional who enjoys working with data, reporting, and supporting marketing operations? We’re looking for a Home-Based Marketing Admin (Data Analyst) to join our DCX team. The role demands strong skills in data analysis, visualization, and marketing performance reporting for complex multi-partner operations. The position supports marketing strategy by identifying trends and suggesting budget optimizations, with clear communication of findings to non-technical stakeholders as a critical requirement.

REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES 

  • Excellent Communicator: Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Analytical & Research-Driven: Comfortable analyzing marketing data, preparing reports, and identifying trends to support business decisions.

  • Customer-Focused: Dedicated to providing excellent internal support while understanding customer needs and business objectives.

  • Collaborative Team Player: Works effectively with cross-functional teams and adapts well in a dynamic work environment. 

​WHAT YOU WILL DO 

  • Pull data from marketing systems and synthesize it into clear, digestible reports.

  • Produce weekly reporting that provides clear insights on lead generation and marketing channel performance.

  • Build dashboards comparing actual lead flow to budgeted expectations, using visuals such as graphs and scorecards.

  • Highlight areas of success and areas needing improvement to guide partner marketing decisions.

  • Support reporting for approximately 15-16 different roofing partners, each requiring unique data interpretation.

  • Prepare visuals designed for fast understanding by stakeholders.

  • Assemble reports (including some copy-paste tasks) as well as provide analysis and commentary on the data.

  • Identify trends in the data and suggest budget optimizations to support overall marketing strategy.

  • Communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR 

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, and Business Administration, or any related field.  

  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Marketing, Data Analysis, or a related role.

  • Language Proficiency: Strong verbal, written, and English communication skills. 

  • Working schedule: Ability to work overnight/graveyard shifts in Philippine time or within US operating hours.  

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proficient in using Google Analytics, Google Ads, Power BI, AccuLynx, Ahrefs, and BrightLocal.

    • Comfortable pulling data from CRM systems (HubSpot), Google Analytics, SEO tools, and lead traffic sources, and synthesizing it into reports.

    • Proficiency with visual analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Google Looker Studio is preferred; candidates with experience in any of these platforms will have an advantage.

    • Strong data analysis, visualization, and marketing performance reporting skills.

    • Candidates should be comfortable pulling data from these tools and synthesizing it into reports.

    • Experience analyzing SEO metrics or sales conversion data is beneficial but secondary to reporting ability.

    • Ability to understand charts and spreadsheets to extract valuable insights.

    • Simple but effective presentation skills for preparing stakeholder-ready visuals.

    • Reporting is the main focus of the role, though some data cleanup duties may arise.

    • The role includes some copy-paste tasks to assemble reports but also requires analysis and commentary.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Salary Range: PHP 38,000 – 48,000

  • Industry: Residential Roofing

  • Job Type: Full-time

  • Work Shift: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (USA)

  • Workdays: Monday through Friday (USA)

  • #DCXWorkFromHome Set-up

BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US

  • Industry-leading salary packages 

  • Permanent work-from-home setup 

  • Company equipment provided 

  • Government-mandated benefits employer share

  • Internet stipends upon regularization 

  • HMO Coverage upon regularization (with an option to enroll as early as Day 1)

  • PTO credits and service incentive leaves 

  • Major spring and winter company live events 

  • Monthly employee appreciation virtual events 

  • Company-provided career skills training courses 

  • A company culture focused on your personal and professional growth

WHO WE ARE

DCX stands out as a leading BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) company that takes pride in assisting growth-focused small and medium-sized businesses across the United States to discover the perfect global talent to enhance their teams. 

At DCX, our core beliefs center around fostering growth and making hiring easy. We are dedicated to helping business owners, executives, and industry leaders, primarily within the promotional products industry, in their search for superstar team members. 


If you are on the lookout for a company that values growth and places a strong emphasis on its people-centered culture, then DCX is the place for you. As we say around here, LET'S GROW!

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/dcx-home-based-marketing-data-analyst

title: Operations Specialist, Virtual Marketing Events
description:
Headquarters: London - 8 Salisbury
URL: http://gartner.com

About the role:

Gartner’s research and insights help business leaders make more effective decisions every day. Our Corporate Marketing team strives to understand the needs of the customers and communities we serve and design the most effective programs to profitably meet those needs. This team accelerates sales activity by attracting, engaging and converting leaders and their teams through the delivery of compelling Gartner insights and experiences throughout the buyer journey.

 

The Operations Specialist - Virtual Events role is responsible for the strategy, logistics and execution of virtual sessions for Gartner prospects and clients across the marketing funnel. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, data-driven  and collaborative, with a strong ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. They are innovative, adaptable, and comfortable working both independently and across teams. This role will report to the Manager, Marketing who is responsible for the operations and optimization of our virtual programs. 

 

What you will do:

Execute and Deliver Live Virtual Programs

  • Host and execute live virtual sessions by introducing presenters, delivering scripted remarks, providing audience guidance, managing promotional announcements, and operating webinar platforms to ensure a seamless attendee experience.

  • Coordinate event preparation and logistics by managing rehearsals, presenter access, training, materials, and session assets to support successful program delivery.

  • Manage content publishing and presentation materials by collecting, reviewing, editing, and uploading presentations, scripts, and promotional content across webinar platforms and Gartner.com.

  • Ensure program quality and readiness by maintaining accurate documentation, monitoring event details, and partnering with stakeholders to proactively resolve issues.

Manage Program Communications and Operations

  • Coordinate stakeholder communications by supporting presenters, sales teams, prospective clients, and internal partners, ensuring timely responses, clear expectations, and smooth program execution.

  • Support program operations and reporting by managing registration tracking, stakeholder updates, participation reporting, and promotional requests in partnership with Digital Marketing teams.

  • Serve as a cross-functional liaison by collaborating with research, marketing, and operational teams to align priorities, manage deadlines, and support program objectives.

Drive Program Performance and Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze program performance by monitoring audience engagement, registration trends, and session metrics to identify insights, benchmarks, and opportunities for growth.

  • Improve program effectiveness by evaluating workflows, promotional channels, and operational processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and audience reach.

  • Advance innovation and operational excellence by recommending new approaches, supporting pilot initiatives, and implementing best practices that enhance program outcomes.

 

What you will need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field preferred

  • Experience with virtual platform content preferred

  • 2-3 years of marketing, operations and/or related experience

  • Experienced user of Excel and PowerPoint

  • Familiarity with Google Drive

  • Effective oral and written communication skills

  • High level of accuracy and proven attention to detail with excellent organizational skills

  • Project Manager mindset who can juggle multiple, competing priorities simultaneously

  • Process-oriented individual who looks to maximize efficiencies in new or existing procedures

  • Someone who is both independent in handling their responsibilities yet willing and able to collaborate with others

  • Analytical mindset that can delve deep into metrics and data to find the narrative behind the numbers

  • Someone who likes an engaging and swift atmosphere that is deadline-dependent and always on the move

 

 

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Medical, Dental & Vision Plans, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 401K matching and more!

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity

  • Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

 

 

#GSSO

#LI-KP2

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.


The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling Human Resources at +1 (203) 964-0096 or by sending an email to ApplicantAccommodations@gartner.com.

title: Gaming Marketing and Events Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote, New Jersey
URL: http://betmgm.com

Discover What’s Possible at BetMGM

Ready to make your career legendary? Join us as we bring the magic of Vegas to our players. The BetMGM team has over 1,400 talented members, revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We’re a brand with technology at our hearts and the most driven and focused talent in the business.

As a valued team member, we’re committed to giving you the resources and support you need to thrive. Our benefits and perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Pre-tax spending accounts including health care FSA and commuter savings

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Professional development reimbursement and ongoing skills training opportunities

  • Employee resource groups

  • Swag, ticket giveaways, and more!

At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win. 

 

 

The Gaming Marketing & Events Manager is a critical, highly visible role that serves as a linchpin between BetMGM’s digital gaming organization and MGM Resorts International’s land‑based casino portfolio. The role is responsible for ensuring seamless alignment between online and retail gaming experiences by positioning and promoting BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) brands effectively across MGM properties with a focus on MGM Grand Detroit & Borgata Hotel, Casino & Spa.

 

 

Location: Must be located in NJ or Detroit, MI

About the Role

The Gaming Marketing & Events Manager is a critical, highly visible role that serves as a linchpin between BetMGM’s digital gaming organization and MGM Resorts International’s land‑based casino portfolio.  The role is responsible for ensuring seamless alignment between online and retail gaming experiences by positioning and promoting BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) brands effectively across MGM properties with a focus on MGM Grand Detroit & Borgata Hotel, Casino & Spa.

Responsibilities

Acting as one of the primary points of contact for MGM, the Gaming Marketing & Events Manager will work alongside the Sr. Manager in strategy, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing initiatives which inspire existing land-based players to choose BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) as their preferred online gaming destination.  This individual will play a key role in strengthening brand awareness, customer conversion, and long-term loyalty across our physical and digital channels. In addition, the Gaming Marketing & Events Manager will lead and oversee gaming event/activation execution. Some examples this includes are on-property Big Pull events, VIP experience weekends with MGMAir & co-branded digital-to-retail campaigns that drive player acquisition and engagement through Betting Hero. The role will partner closely with MGM marketing and special events teams, to ensure cohesive brand representation and seamless execution and guest experience.

The ideal candidate will be an experienced gaming expert with a land-based casino events/marketing background who is passionate about the industry. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively with many other key stakeholders located across both BetMGM and MGM Resorts International.

  • Manage relationships between the BetMGM (MI)/Borgata Online (NJ) gaming teams and our land-based estate of MGM properties, with the principal goal of ensuring our BetMGM (MI)/Borgata Online (NJ) gaming labels are well advertised and presented within the properties. Timely support, regular communications, and prompt assistance with issues will all be commonplace.

  • Partner with MGM Property Special Events and Marketing teams to support balanced brand placements, on-property activations, and promotional visibility aligned with internal campaign calendars.

  • Serve as a day-to-day liaison between property teams (event operations and digital/physical signage) for BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) to coordinate logistics, staffing, promotional materials, and compliance requirements.

  • Oversee and provide day-to-day direction to the BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) gaming events/marketing team, guiding planning timelines, task prioritization, vendor coordination, and on-site execution to ensure successful delivery of all casino-related events and on-site activations.

  • Leverage the MGM Property Special Events calendar to see where omni-channel opportunities are possible to stand up.

  • Oversee and provide day-to-day direction to the gaming events/marketing team, guiding planning timelines, task prioritization, vendor coordination, and on-site execution to ensure successful delivery of all gaming-related events and activations.

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute gaming-related property events, including tournaments, promotional activations, VIP experiences, and brand showcases. Ensure events are delivered on time, on budget, and aligned with brand standards.

  • Maintain and manage a property-level gaming event calendar, ensuring alignment with marketing campaigns, seasonal initiatives, and corporate objectives.

  • Serve as a day-to-day liaison between property teams, event operations, and BetMGM (MI)/Borgata Online (NJ) gaming events/marketing team to coordinate logistics, staffing, promotional materials, and compliance requirements.

  • Support on-site event execution as needed, including betting hero support, vendor coordination, event setup, compliance, signage placement and troubleshooting.

  • Partner with the Business Intelligence team to analyze campaign and event performance, tracking KPIs such as attendance, new player acquisition, engagement, and ROI. Provide recommendations for improvement based on findings.

  • Collaborate with the CRM and Loyalty teams to support targeted communications for property-based campaigns and event promotions, ensuring messaging is timely and performance-driven.

  • Conduct competitive research on omnichannel gaming and property-based event strategies to identify trends, promotional mechanics, and opportunities for differentiation.

Essential Functions

  • Must be able to stand or sit and operate computers and other technological devices for extended periods of time.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a gaming license in applicable jurisdictions as a condition of hire and continued employment.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly to MGM Grand Detroit & Borgata Hotel, Casino & Spa MGM properties to support planning meetings, team oversight, and on-site event execution, including evenings and weekends as business needs require.

Qualifications  

  • 3+ years of experience in gaming, marketing, event management, hospitality, or related industry, with demonstrated ownership of live event execution.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly to east coast regional MGM properties to support planning meetings, team oversight, and on-site event execution, including evenings and weekends as business needs require.

  • Proven experience leading or directing an events team, providing day-to-day guidance, setting priorities, and ensuring accountability across planning and execution phases.

  • Demonstrated success executing live events and on-property activations, including vendor coordination, cross-functional alignment, budget management, and real-time problem-solving.

  • Experience collaborating across multiple departments (marketing, operations, VIP services, hospitality, and property leadership) to deliver integrated campaigns and seamless guest experiences.

  • Knowledge of online and land-based casino operations is preferred, with understanding of regulatory considerations in highly controlled environments.

  • Familiarity with regional MGM Resorts properties and/or BetMGM’s product ecosystem preferred.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously while balancing regional priorities.

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience analyzing performance data, presenting insights clearly, and translating findings into actionable strategies.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels.

  • Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

The annual salary range for this position is $100000 to $125000.  Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.  This position is also eligible for participation in a performance-based bonus plan.

Applicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration sponsorship. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship including H-1B, O-1, E-3, TN, OPT, etc.

Gaming Compliance & Licensing Requirements 

As an online gaming company, BetMGM is required to comply with state gaming regulations which includes licensing obligations.  Applicable employees must be licensed by at least one jurisdictional agency, although certain positions require licensing by multiple agencies.  Failure to become licensed or maintain licensure with each agency as required for the role may result in termination of employment.  Please note that the licensing process includes comprehensive background checks which may include a review of criminal records, financial history, and personal background verification.

In addition, candidates must comply with and support BetMGM's responsible gambling policies, procedures, and initiatives.

 

 

About BetMGM

BetMGM is revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We are a partnership between two powerhouse organizations—MGM Resorts International and Entain Group. You know our name through our exciting portfolio of brands including BetMGM Casino, BetMGM Sportsbook, Borgata Online, Party Casino and Party Poker. We aim to bring our ideas into action and find ways to deliver the best quality in gaming platforms.

BetMGM LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, age, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. As an organization, we are unwavering in our commitment to maintaining a discrimination-free work environment, and fostering a culture of inclusivity, belonging and equal opportunity for all employees and applicants.

If you need assistance or accommodation with your application due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@betmgm.com.

 

 

This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of duties a person in this position may be asked to perform from time to time.

title: Marketing Automation Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States
URL: http://clearesult.com

At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Additionally, you will enjoy:
• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; we also offer a company-paid health care concierge service to help navigate our health plan to make the best decisions for you and yours
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation, sick, personal and parental leave time
• Paid Volunteer Time: giving back to our communities is important to us
• Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards
• Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities
• Access to on-demand training courses to advance further in your career

Job Description

We are looking for a talented individual to join our team as a remotely-based Marketing Automation Analyst!

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Marketing Automation Analyst to support our email marketing initiatives and drive performance through Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC). This role will be responsible for building, deploying, and analyzing email campaigns and journeys for low to medium complexity accounts, with a focus on optimizing engagement and revenue outcomes.​

​

For this opportunity, you’re a great fit if you can…

  • Independently create medium-complexity emails in SFMC, including formatting, coding, and adding text, images, and dynamic content.

  • Deploy medium to high-complexity email campaigns using SFMC.

  • Develop and execute low-complexity deployment strategies to support campaign goals.

  • Set up and manage email journeys and triggered email campaigns within SFMC.

  • Monitor and report on email performance for low to medium complexity accounts.

  • Analyze campaign results and translate insights into client-facing presentations.

description:

We are seeking a Regional Civil Design Engineering Project Manager working remotely in and around the West region(California, Oregon, Washington, Arizona) of the United States. Reporting to the West Region VP of Construction and Design. The Regional Civil Design Engineering Project Manager  will be working with the Sales and Construction teams and guide the athletic facility design process. Engineer will help design, manage and complete the West Regional Design project workloads including Autocad production drawings, permitting, and performing stormwater design and calculations utilizing HydroCAD and/or Hydraflow for hydraulics and hydrology tasks. Work will be for all levels of athletic facilities and accompanying infrastructure design and construction.

Tarkett Sports is a world leader in sports construction and surfacing. Providing architectural design, full-scope construction services, and a comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading sports surfacing solutions, Tarkett Sports delivers a seamless turnkey experience for its clients.


At Tarkett Sports, everything we do – and the way we do it – is aimed to make the process easier for you. We focus on ensuring your experience is memorable and hassle free.

We understood long ago that a successful sports surface relies on a quality product that’s installed by a quality team. We’ve built our family by combining the best people and the best partners with the best products.

If you're looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact and grow your career with an industry leader, this is your chance!

What You’ll Do:

  • Prepare and manage production of civil design/construction plans, including notes, details, plan and profile sheets, and cross-sections. Prepare schedules, assign projects, update project data base
  • Prepare and negotiate design agreements including schedule, scope, and budget
  • Prepare and submit project permitting packages.
  • Lead the team in preparing technical storm water calculations for athletic facility development.
  • Prepare technical reports, memos, and exhibits to support project documentation.
  • Perform technical review of drawings, specifications, calculations, shop drawings, and other engineering documents for conformance with industry standards and company recommendations
  • Perform preliminary engineering evaluations, including quantity take-offs and opinions of probable construction cost.
  • Conduct research and select technical reference data for project specifications.
  • Support the sales team with concept designs and sales meetings with clients.
  • Highly communicative role—must be comfortable interacting with jurisdictions, peers, clients, and supervisors to ensure project success.
  • Ensure compliance with company safety regulations, standard operating procedures, and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with installation crews, subcontractors, and sales teams to resolve technical and operational challenges.
  • Perform site construction visits and prepare associated field reports.
  • Review and approve subcontractor invoices and assist project managers in billing, design, and engineering tasks.
  • Oversee project closeout, including Certificates of Completion, As-Builts, and final checklists.
  • Provide subject matter expertise to sales and customers to secure contracts.

Experience & Education Desired:  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field, or a technical school degree with equivalent experience.
  • Professional Engineering (PE) License preferred(CA, OR, WA), with 6-10 years’ experience and the with ability for licensure reciprocity in neighboring jurisdictions.
  • Experience in civil site design, including site layout, grading, drainage, water, sewer, earthwork, and sediment control preferred.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D for drafting and design.
  • Strong leadership skill:
    • Lead the regional Design & Sales Process: Organize and assemble scope for new design projects with sales, customers, and local contractors
  • Strong multitasking and crisis management skills, including handling customer service demands, construction RFIs, and installation challenges.
  • Experience with bidding and estimating processes, ensuring proper budget allocation and project scope completion.
  • Ability to track projects and maintain communication with project teams, customers, and sales throughout execution.
  • Knowledge of material compliance and subcontractor coordination, including visiting regional aggregate quarries and civil partners.
  • Ensure all projects are closed out in a timely fashion at or under budget with customers fully engaged with completion and punch-list complete
  • Attend sales meetings with Regional Sales Managers to outline minimum civil details and design recommendations
  • Visit regional aggregate quarries, verify material compliance
  • Visit with regional civil partners and subcontractors
  • Attend and participate in Weekly Regional Conference calls (WIP Calls)

title: Senior Software Design Assurance (Sr Software Design Quality) Engineer
description:
Headquarters: San Diego
URL: http://dexcom.com

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

 

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

*This is NOT a test role*

The Senior Software Design Assurance (Sr Software Design Quality) Engineer provides technical support and guidance to Software teams to ensure conformance to software development process and other applicable safety and quality system regulation and standards (e.g. IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971).

This role will be responsible for various aspects of Software Design Assurance with a focus on product improvement, new product development, and defect prevention. This position will interface with different cross functional groups (Software Engineering, Software Test, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Project

managers, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, and others). A positive attitude is important while working in a fast-paced environment and dealing with shifting priorities.

*This is NOT a test role*

Where you come in:

  • You will actively participate as a core member of the R&D Quality Assurance Engineering team, supporting software design assurance for cloud‑based, data platform, and AI/ML‑enabled systems.

  • You will provide hands‑on technical guidance to cross‑functional teams on IEC 62304, 21 CFR 820, and other applicable global regulations for software‑as‑a‑service, data, and AI‑driven products.

  • You will lead the effective application, compliance, and continuous improvement of software development and validation practices for distributed systems, cloud services, and data platforms.

  • You will drive pre‑market risk management deliverables, including Software Hazard Analysis (SHA), design FMEA, and risk controls related to cloud infrastructure, data processing, and AI/ML functionality.

  • You will guide Software Design and Test teams on software design assurance activities such as requirements traceability, software configuration management, tool validation, and integration of cloud and data services.

  • You will review and approve software design control deliverables associated with cloud‑hosted services, data pipelines, and AI/ML components to ensure regulatory compliance and product quality.

  • You will support post‑market activities related to software anomalies, model behavior, data quality issues, risk assessments, and CAPA activities, as applicable.

  • You will author, review, and maintain technical documentation including Design History Files, SOPs, protocols, and reports for cloud‑based and AI/ML‑enabled systems.

  • You will assess change control activities related to infrastructure, data, or model changes to ensure no adverse impact to product performance and to maintain a compliant state.

  • You will effectively communicate plans, progress, risks, and design assurance considerations to cross‑functional teams and senior leadership.

What makes you successful:

•     Nice to have: AI/ML experience or ASQ CSQE certification.

  • You bring strong experience in software design assurance for cloud‑based, data platform, API, and service‑oriented systems in a regulated environment.

  • You have demonstrated hands‑on knowledge of IEC 62304, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, and their application to software‑as‑a‑service and data‑driven products.

  • Your proficiency includes applying software design assurance principles across the SDLC, including requirements analysis, architecture and design reviews, implementation oversight, integration, and verification.

  • You have experience performing and reviewing software risk management activities, including Software Hazard Analysis (SHA), design FMEA, and change impact assessments for cloud, data, and AI/ML components.

  • You are skilled at reviewing and approving software design control deliverables to ensure traceability, risk control implementation, and regulatory compliance.

  • You have experience supporting software configuration management, tool validation, and integration of cloud services, data pipelines, and platform components.

  • You communicate effectively with cross‑functional partners and can clearly present design assurance, risk, and compliance topics to technical teams and senior leadership.

What you’ll get: (this section should not be modified)

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.

  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.

  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 5-15%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 5-8 years related experience or Master’s degree and 2-5 years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 0-2 years experience

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region â this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

Â 

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

Â 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Â 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Â 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

title: Senior Business Development Representative
description:
Headquarters: Austria, Linz
URL: https://otterly.ai/

Role Overview:

We're looking for an experienced New Business Development Representative who knows how to create opportunities, not just wait for them. 

This is a senior outbound role focused on building high-quality pipelines for our Account Executive team, whom you will work with closely on a daily basis.. You'll identify target accounts, engage decision-makers through multi-channel outreach, qualify opportunities, and book meetings with companies that have meaningful revenue potential.

You'll have the autonomy and freedom to test messaging, refine outbound strategies, and help shape how OtterlyAI goes to market. We care about quality over quantity—you'll focus on opening doors where OtterlyAI can create meaningful business impact, not simply hitting activity metrics.

Main Responsibilities:


1. Outbound Pipeline Generation: Build and manage outbound campaigns targeting marketing leaders, SEO teams, digital agencies, and enterprise organizations using LinkedIn, email, phone, and other creative outreach channels.
2. Account-Based Prospecting: Research and prioritize high-value accounts, identify key stakeholders, and develop personalized outreach that cuts through the noise.
3. Multi-Channel Outreach: Execute thoughtful cold and warm outreach across LinkedIn,
email, calling, and other channels to consistently generate qualified meetings.
4. Opportunity Qualification: Understand prospect pain points, qualify opportunities, and ensure every meeting handed to an Account Executive has a strong likelihood of progressing.
5. Pipeline Development: Own your pipeline targets by generating qualified opportunities that contribute directly to company growth and revenue.
6. Market Intelligence: Continuously gather insights from prospects, competitors, and the AI search landscape to improve messaging and identify new opportunities.
7. Process Improvement: Help optimize outbound playbooks, messaging, sequencing, and targeting as we continue to scale our sales motion.

Main Requirements:

Must Have:

  • 4+ years of outbound BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS ( MarTech, SEO, AI or Digital Marketing Solutions)

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding outbound meeting or pipeline targets

  • Experience prospecting into mid-market and enterprise organizations

  • Strong LinkedIn, email, and cold-calling skills

  • Experience using tools: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, or similar outbound tools

  • Fluent English (C1+)

  • Self-starter who enjoys ownership in a fast-growing remote scale-up

  • Available to collaborate across EU and US time zones.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Account-Based Sales (ABS) or Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Additional European languages

  • Experience building outbound campaigns from scratch.


What OtterlyAI Offers:

  • €4,000/month base (B2B contractor arrangement)

  • Uncapped commission based on qualified pipeline and closed business

  • Remote-first - work from anywhere in Europe

  • Flexible schedule with overlap across Europe and US timezones

  • Direct collaboration with founders and sales leadership

  • Opportunity to help define and scale OtterlyAI's outbound motion


Recruitment Process:

  1. CV and brief selection:
    When submitting your CV, please also include a short note of 3 - 4 paragraphs covering:

  • Your most successful outbound campaign

  • The most creative way you've booked a difficult prospect

  • One insight about the future of AI search or SEO

  1. Video Call: If your CV and brief note aligns with our requirements, HR invites you for an initial video call.

  2. Interview with the CRO: A deeper discussion about your experience, sales methodology, and previous achievements.

  3. Challenge: Create an outreach strategy to high-tier leads for OtterlyAI prospects. 

  4. Final Interview: Meet the founders and discuss how you would help OtterlyAI scale. 

  5. Offer: If all goes well, we'll share an offer, and you can start your journey with Otterly.ai

title: VP Revenue
description:
Mongoose is the leading AI Engagement Platform in higher education. Colleges and universities use us to increase enrollment, retention, and fundraising — without adding staff.


We have the product and the customers. What we don't have yet is a revenue engine to match. That's this role. As VP of Revenue, you own it end to end — new business, client success, account management, and, most importantly, the system that ties them together. Your job is to make it simple and run it with discipline.



What You'll Do


  • Own all of revenue. The whole revenue org reports to you — one team, one leader. New business, client success, and account management are the front line, with enablement and operations behind them — the training and tools that set them up to win. It all serves one goal: grow ARR — by winning new business and helping our customers succeed. So you're measured on two things: new ARR and gross retention.




  • Build a simple, repeatable selling system. One clear path from first call to close to renewal — the stages, standards, and playbooks the whole team runs the same way. Make it so clear that reps know what good looks like and spend their time selling, not guessing. Done right, it shows up in forecasts you can trust, faster deals, and better conversion at every step.




  • Grow the people who sell it. Our reps are early in their careers and hungry, so growing them isn't a side project — it's the job. You build the system that does it: ramp, enablement, and a steady coaching cadence. And you're in it, not above it — in the deals and the reviews, helping close and coaching the fundamentals in the moment, not from a slide at quarter's end. The result is reps who sell with real confidence and conviction: they know how to win, and they believe they will.




  • Move us up-market. Our next stage of growth is in bigger deals. You know where the real opportunity lives in higher ed, and you focus the team there — raising the ACV we pursue, building around the highest-value accounts, and growing the ones with real upside. It takes sharp market judgment, a head for the numbers, and the discipline to say no to deals that aren't worth the team's time.




  • Run revenue like an AI company. Most revenue orgs still operate the way they did decades ago — we won't. We sell AI for a living, and the whole company is getting far more efficient, accurate, and effective by letting AI do the manual work. That takes more than watching for the next AI tool — it takes imagination: you picture how technology could reinvent the work, then we build it.






What You'll Bring


  • You've run a full revenue org — new business and retention both — and carried a number yourself, not just managed people who carried theirs.




  • When a number gets missed, you go straight to the funnel math — pipeline, conversion, time-in-stage — not the story about why.




  • You've built a selling system that works — whether you stood it up from scratch or overhauled a broken one inside an established org.




  • You're a real coach. You've taken early-career reps and turned them into closers — hands-on, not from a dashboard.




  • You think in unit economics and read a market fast. You've moved a team toward bigger, better deals, and had the discipline to walk from the rest.




  • You're already using AI to reinvent how you work, and you don't wait for permission to push it further.




  • Higher ed or EdTech experience is a strong plus, not a must. The market has real nuance — if you haven't lived in it, show us how you'll close the gap fast.






How We WorkRevenue doesn't run in isolation. You're a key member of our senior leadership team — leading revenue alongside the CEO, partnering with Product and Marketing on go-to-market, and with Finance and People to run the business. Tight feedback loops, honest calls, shared decisions. We hold each other accountable to the plan — and to the whole outcome, not just our own lane.


More About Mongoose

1,000+ higher ed institutions already trust Mongoose — built to give their teams exponentially more capacity across the systems they already run.


AI handles the routine, so people can focus on the work that actually moves students forward — more applications completed, more students retained, more donors reached. Same team. Much bigger impact.



What We Offer

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401K with company match: 100% of the 1st 3% and 50% of the next 2%

  • Flexible PTO

  • Competitive Leave Policies

  • 13 paid holidays, including a week off between Christmas and New Year’s




The BasicsRemote, anywhere in the US. Some travel — for customers, for big deals, and for time together as a team.
 
At Mongoose, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and inclusion builds stronger teams. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know—we’re here to help.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Headquarters: Brazil
URL: http://lawnstarter.com

About LawnStarter

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and related services, with over $100M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all outdoor home services - pest control, pool cleaning, window cleaning, and more.

About Engineering at LawnStarter

Our engineering team builds the platform that connects hundreds of thousands of homeowners with over 70,000 active service pros. We operate three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, HomeGnome) on shared infrastructure, and we're profitable and growing. Engineering here is fast - we ship constantly, we own our systems end-to-end, and we don't tolerate "not my problem." We have strong processes and existing engineering managers, so you're not building from scratch. You're raising the bar.

The Role

We're growing, and that means adding engineering leadership capacity to support new initiatives. You'll lead cross-functional delivery teams of 4-5 engineers, reporting to our Head of Engineering. Your job is to make sure your team ships reliably, grows professionally, and doesn't become a bottleneck as LawnStarter scales into new service verticals.

This is a people-first role. If your identity as an EM is primarily technical - if you'd rather review architecture than develop an underperformer - this isn't the right fit. If you're the manager who knows what every person on your team needs to grow, who handles conflict directly, and who can articulate team performance in metrics, keep reading.

What makes this role different:

- You'll own both delivery AND people outcomes - neither can be delegated

- Distributed team across time zones, so async leadership and written communication matter as much as meetings

- We move fast and actually ship - you'll feel the difference between a team that's humming and one that's stuck

- AI-forward is not a buzzword here - we expect you to lead your team on how to use it, not just follow along

What You'll Own

- People development: Concrete growth plans for every IC on your team - not just the struggling ones. You know where each person is going and what it takes to get there.

- Delivery: Your team ships on cadence with predictable quality. You surface risk early, manage scope, and don't miss commitments without warning.

- Team health: Conflict gets addressed directly. Underperformers are managed with a clear process. Top performers are protected and developed.

- Cross-functional partnership: You're the interface between your team and Product, Design, and other engineering teams. Decisions get made, not stalled.

- Technical direction: Close enough to the work to weigh in on system design and catch architectural risks. Not so close that you're in the weeds instead of removing blockers.

- AI adoption: You're actively introducing AI tools and workflows into how your team operates - code review, documentation, sprint planning, debugging. You set the pace, not follow it.

Problems to Solve

Building people leadership depth as the team scales

LawnStarter is expanding into new service verticals quickly. That means new headcount, new complexity, and more pressure on EMs to develop the next generation of senior engineers and tech leads - not just ship features. We need an EM who's done this before, not one who's figuring it out.

Managing distributed teams without losing culture or accountability

Our engineering team spans multiple time zones and countries. Async communication, remote 1:1s, and distributed sprint ceremonies are the norm - not a workaround. An EM who needs daily in-person proximity to lead effectively won't thrive here.

Turning delivery consistency into a competitive advantage

We have product-market fit and real momentum. The constraint now is shipping reliably enough to compound on that momentum. Your team's velocity and predictability directly affects LawnStarter's ability to launch new services and capture market share.

Orchestrating cross-functional delivery from roadmap to release

An EM here is the connective tissue between Product, Design, and specialist functions - quality engineering, architecture, and security - from estimation through delivery. The hard part isn't running any one of those conversations well; it's running all of them in parallel without becoming the bottleneck they route through.
