title: Expertise Path and Manager Path
description:
30+ Engineering Career Ladders

Before jumping into the list, let's quickly discuss software engineering career ladders. We can extract common traits from those career ladders; understanding those characteristics allows us to connect the dots more easily and compare different career ladders efficiently.

What Is a Career Ladder?

A career ladder, or career path, is a progression framework. It allows an organization to describe the different job levels and the expectations for a given position.

It enables the assessment of a software engineer's skills and to work on her career progression. It provides a shared framework to identify the different aspects to improve to reach the next job level.

The ladder can also be mapped with employee's compensation, increasing salaries transparency, and fairness.

Expertise Path and Manager Path (Dual-Track)

Most of the software engineering career ladders are dual tracks ladders.

They have a joint base for the first positions, and at some point, two paths are possible the expertise path and the people management path. The expertise path is often named the individual contributor track, the people management path is often called the manager track.

The career path depends on the stage of the company and the size of the team. New positions will usually appear while the engineering group is growing.

Example for a tiny team (up to 10 engineers)

You'll rarely find ladders at that scale; it's still very early stage, the team is a handful of engineers working with a CTO or a Tech Lead. In startups, the engineering lead is often the technical Co-founder and CTO.

Single Track Notes Engineer Creating solutions to business problems Senior Engineer Handling most complex parts and mentoring Engineering Lead She may handle people management aspects

At this stage, it's pretty common to have one lead developer or engineering lead who owns technical guidance and organizes the team's delivery. She is often more focused on delivery and does not handle people management which a founder still handles.

Example for a small team (~20 engineers)

At that point, the company will introduce middle management positions, usually an Engineering Manager (EM) position. The EM supports a group of 5 to 10 engineers, especially on human resources and project management aspects (ex: hiring, onboarding, organizing, coaching, delivery plan, reporting).

In some companies, EM can be very hands-on on the system part and provide technical and architecture guidance, playing both technical leader and people/team leader. Usually, the company starts to split tech guidance and people management; both require significant and specific expertise.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer - Senior Engineer - Tech Lead Engineering Manager

Example for a medium team (50+ engineers)

You'll start to have more levels and more expert positions at that stage. The company has usually introduced the role of Head of Engineering, Engineering Director, or VP Engineering. This role is about leading the whole engineering department; the engineering managers will report the person having this role.

Leadership has usually introduced another new role to support the technical guidance at a broader scale, for the whole system or a large part of the system. This role can be named Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, etc.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer - Senior Engineer - Tech Lead Engineering Manager Staff Engineer VP Engineering

Example for a large team (100 to 1000+ engineers)

At this stage, the engineering department will create a lot of new intermediary positions to capture the level of expertise and area of ownership and impact. Welcome to Senior Engineer I and II, Engineering Director, etc.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer I - Engineer II - Senior Engineer I - Senior Engineer II - Tech Lead Engineering Manager Senior Tech Lead Senior Engineering Manager Staff Engineer Engineering Director Senior Staff Engineer Senior Engineering Director Principal Engineer VP Engineering Senior Principal Engineer Senior VP Engineering

Public Engineering Career Ladders

Here is a curated list of 30+ public software engineering career ladders; in those resources, you can also find some explanations about why and how those ladders have been introduced.

  • Akeneo

tip

I formerly gathered and reviewed this extensive list of engineering career ladders to get inspiration to craft the first version of our career framework at Akeneo. I hope this list will help you design your own or better understand your existing career ladder. Do you know a great career ladder not present on this list? DM me on Twitter, and let's keep completing this list!

I wrote a free guide to help engineering managers to overcome challenges you may face when stepping up into this position. This guide explores the critical aspects to tackle to succeed in this transition, such as changing your focus, managing your time, and leading and growing a talented team of software engineers.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Headquarters: UK
URL: https://zapiet.com/

Location: Remote, with a preference for candidates based in the UK
Salary: £40,000–£50,000 per year, depending on experience
Bonus: Performance-related bonus
Reporting to: Chief Marketing Officer and Chief Executive Officer

This is a remote role, and we welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates in other locations. However, candidates based in the UK are preferred due to working hours and the need to collaborate closely with Zapiet’s leadership team.

About Zapiet

Zapiet helps Shopify merchants offer exceptional pickup, delivery and shipping experiences.

Our products are used by more than 10,000 merchants around the world, from independent businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands. We are a remote, bootstrapped SaaS company with ambitious plans for the next stage of our growth.

We are looking for a commercially focused Head of Marketing to help more merchants discover, adopt and succeed with Zapiet’s products.

The role

As Head of Marketing, your primary responsibility will be to increase revenue by driving awareness, adoption and continued use of Zapiet’s products.

You will turn our wider company and marketing strategy into focused campaigns that generate measurable results. You will own the marketing funnel, from discovery and acquisition through to activation, expansion and retention.

You will also manage and grow a team of internal and external specialists across email marketing, SEO, answer engine optimisation, content, communications and other marketing disciplines.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable setting strategy, managing specialists, analysing performance and stepping in to help execute when needed.

You will work closely with our CMO, CEO, product, sales, partnerships and customer support teams.

Your responsibilities

Increase product adoption and revenue

  • Develop and deliver marketing plans that increase installations, product adoption and recurring revenue.

  • Identify the biggest opportunities within our acquisition, activation, retention and expansion funnels.

  • Create campaigns that clearly communicate how Zapiet’s products help merchants increase revenue, reduce costs and improve their operations.

  • Increase adoption across Zapiet’s complete product portfolio through cross-selling, product education and lifecycle marketing.

  • Support new product and feature launches with clear positioning, messaging and go-to-market plans.

  • Develop campaigns for specific industries, merchant segments and geographic markets.

  • Turn merchant success stories into compelling case studies, campaigns and sales materials.

Own marketing performance

  • Set clear targets and KPIs for every marketing channel.

  • Build reporting that connects marketing activity to installations, qualified opportunities, product adoption and recurring revenue.

  • Monitor performance across the full funnel and identify where merchants are dropping off.

  • Run structured experiments to improve conversion, activation and retention.

  • Manage the marketing budget and allocate resources to the channels producing the strongest commercial results.

  • Report performance, insights and priorities directly to the CMO and CEO.

Lead and grow the marketing team

  • Manage and develop a team of specialists across email marketing, SEO, AEO, content and communications.

  • Recruit additional expertise as the marketing function grows.

  • Set clear goals, responsibilities and performance expectations.

  • Create an environment where specialists can do their best work while remaining accountable for measurable outcomes.

  • Coordinate internal team members, agencies, freelancers and technology partners.

  • Ensure campaigns are delivered on time and to a consistently high standard.

Strengthen Zapiet’s market position

  • Refine the positioning and messaging of Zapiet and its products.

  • Improve Zapiet’s visibility across search engines, AI answer platforms, industry publications and the wider Shopify ecosystem.

  • Build relationships with Shopify agencies, technology partners, influencers and ecommerce communities.

  • Identify emerging changes in SaaS marketing, ecommerce discovery and merchant buying behaviour.

  • Ensure Zapiet’s communications are clear, distinctive and consistent across every channel.

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience marketing SaaS products, ideally within ecommerce, Shopify or B2B software.

  • A proven record of increasing product adoption, recurring revenue or qualified pipeline through marketing.

  • Experience leading and developing a multidisciplinary marketing team.

  • Strong knowledge of lifecycle and email marketing, SEO, content, communications and product marketing.

  • A practical understanding of answer engine optimisation and how AI is changing product discovery.

  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market plans for products and features.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect marketing activity with commercial results.

  • Experience setting targets, managing budgets and reporting performance to senior leadership.

  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to keep multiple campaigns moving.

  • Native-level written and spoken English, with exceptional attention to detail.

  • A willingness to be hands-on and take ownership of outcomes.

You will do well in this role if you

  • Think about revenue and product adoption, not vanity metrics.

  • Can turn a broad strategy into a focused and achievable plan.

  • Understand how acquisition, activation, retention and expansion work together.

  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions and testing new ideas.

  • Know how to lead experts without needing to be the deepest specialist in every discipline.

  • Communicate openly, make decisions using evidence and take responsibility for results.

  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving, international and remote environment.

How success will be measured

Your performance will be assessed against agreed commercial and marketing targets, which may include:

  • Growth in marketing-attributed recurring revenue.

  • Growth in product installations and qualified merchant opportunities.

  • Improvements in trial-to-paid and install-to-activation conversion.

  • Increased adoption of additional Zapiet products.

  • Growth in organic, email, partner and AI-assisted discovery channels.

  • Merchant retention and expansion revenue.

  • The performance and development of the marketing team.

  • Efficient use of the marketing budget.

A performance-related bonus will be paid based on the achievement of agreed targets.

What we offer

  • A salary of £40,000–£50,000 per year, depending on experience.

  • A performance-related bonus.

  • Remote and flexible working.

  • The opportunity to shape the marketing strategy of an established, international SaaS company.

  • Direct access to Zapiet’s CMO and CEO.

  • The freedom to build a talented marketing team and introduce new ideas.

  • The opportunity to work with Shopify merchants, agencies and technology partners around the world.

Equal opportunities

Zapiet welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds. We make hiring decisions based on experience, ability and the contribution each person can make to our team.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zapiet-head-of-marketing

title: Technical Recruiter 2026 New Graduate
description:
About Radiant

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the worldâs first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The companyâs first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiantâs unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

About the Role

Radiant is seeking a driven recent grad to join our talent team and help build the engineering teams behind Kaleidos, our portable, mass-producible nuclear microreactor targeting commercial deployment in 2028. This is a role for someone who wants to start a career in recruitment, work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with real ownership and influence, build a deep tech career, and learn about several technical domains like nuclear, hardware, electrical, software, and more. You'll get close mentorship from recruiters and sourcers who've built teams before, regular visibility with executives, own requisitions, and find top talent for engineering leaders and their teams.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Run your own reqs from open to close, building the pipeline, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and getting offers signed.

  • Find niche talent markets for specialized engineering roles in places like GitHub repos, arXiv papers, technical mailing lists, tech foundation communities, conference speaker rosters, and academic programs.

  • Create talent market reports based on research you drive to help make better-informed recruiting strategies.

  • Coordinate interviews and help facilitate hiring team debriefs to keep decisions moving quickly.

  • Sit in on offer conversations with senior recruiters and learn how strategy and closing work in practice.

  • Help shape how Radiant recruits; the processes, tools, and 3rd party platforms you help build and adopt now become the foundation the team scales on.

  • Get hands-on exposure to hiring across multiple technical functions: electrical, mechanical, software, and more.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.

  • 0â2 years of experience in recruiting, sales, sourcing, or coordination, or you've picked it up on your own and can point to something that proves it.

  • Something outside the classroom that shows real team influence, a club you led, student government, a project you built, a sport you competed in, or work you volunteered for.

  • A genuine pull toward hardware, nuclear, physics, or AI/ML; you don't need an engineering background, just real curiosity.

  • A bias toward action: you move quickly, problem-solve on the fly, and know when to raise your hand for help.

  • You're able to hold a genuine conversation with technical candidates, curious enough to ask good questions, and honest enough to admit when something's outside your depth.

Desired Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM-related major is a plus.

  • Any prior exposure to hardware, software, engineering, or tech recruiting, even informally.

  • Comfort picking up new tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, sourcing, LLM platforms, even without direct prior experience.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

  • Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

Benefits and Perks

  • Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

  • Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

  • One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

  • Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

  • Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

  • Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

  • 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

  • Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

  • Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

  • Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

  • Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiantâs new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

The best of todayâs advanced reactor builders donât wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If thatâs you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicantâs capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

title: Architectural Interior Designer
description:
This is a remote position.

Only LATAM-based candidates (bilingual in Spanish and English)

We are in search of an experienced Architectural & Interior Designer who is fervent about design and possesses a rich background in both residential and commercial project designs, mainly in kitchens and bathrooms.

As a Kitchen/ Bathrooms Designer/Architect, you will be responsible for the conceptualization and execution of kitchen/bathrooms design projects from inception to completion. This role demands a high level of creativity, attention to detail, and technical proficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Design and plan kitchen/bathroom renovations that meet client specifications and recent trends.
  • Create detailed construction documents for client presentations and supplier coordination.
  • Utilize design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Revit, 3DS Max, and Lumion to produce high-quality visualizations.
  • Engage with clients to refine designs and confirm requirements, ensuring satisfaction and adherence to timelines.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure a cohesive approach to project execution.
  • Creation and elevation of designs using the 20/20 platform.
  • Deployment of the KCDW software for developing and presenting precise kitchen concept visuals.
  • Execution of 3D modeling and elementary rendering for architectural and interior designs utilizing Revit and Sketchup.
  • Production of detailed planimetric sketches employing AutoCAD.

Contract Details

  • Type: International Service Provision
  • In compliance with each Goverment regulations, the contractor will be held responsible for their own social security and tax payments.

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Lumion, 3DS Max, and Revit; knowledge of 20/20 software is a plus.
  • At least 3 years of experience in kitchen design and renovation.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing previous kitchen projects.
  • Excellent understanding of construction documentation and experience with both U.S. and international metric systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with a keen attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a team-oriented environment.
  • Manage and coordinate projects, including tasks related to audit, refurbishment, carpentry, management reporting, reconciliations, urban regeneration, and 3D modeling.
  • Utilize your skills in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop for visual presentations.
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and industry standards in architectural design.

Benefits

Company Overview:

Join a cutting-edge and forward-thinking design firm dedicated to crafting transformative residential and commercial spaces. Our emphasis on creativity, precision, and technical expertise sets us apart.

Remuneration & Benefits

  • Salary: Competitive, subject to experience and expected salary range. All payments will be disbursed in Local Currency.

Why Join Us?

Become an integral part of a dynamic, innovative team that appreciates and recognizes your architectural design proficiency. Your expertise will not only be valued but will also drive the company to new design frontiers.

Application Process

Interested candidates are invited to submit their portfolios and resumes by appling here https://zurl.to/aPRJ?source=CareerSite . Please note that only those shortlisted will be reached out to for further discussion.

Thank you for considering a role with us. We eagerly await your application!

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About Haven Safety:
Haven is transforming how organizations learn from workplace incidents.

Built in partnership with The AES Corporation and backed by AI Fund, Haven applies purpose-built AI to incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and organizational learning. Our platform helps utilities, energy companies, construction firms, and other high-risk industries dramatically reduce investigation effort while improving investigation quality and organizational learning.

We're an early-stage company with enterprise customers, global ambitions, and an experienced leadership team. We're looking for exceptional salespeople who enjoy building a category rather than simply selling software.

The Opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive with a successful track record selling enterprise EHS software. You will own opportunities from discovery through executive alignment, proof of value, commercial negotiation, and close. You will engage Fortune 1000 executives across Safety, Operations, IT, Risk, and Procurement and help customers rethink how work gets done through AI.

\n


Responsibilities Include:
  • Own enterprise sales opportunities from qualification through close.
  • Develop executive relationships across Safety, Operations, IT, Risk, and Procurement.
  • Lead consultative discovery and business value discussions.
  • Demonstrate Haven's platform and ROI.
  • Coordinate pilots and proof-of-value engagements.
  • Build business cases and ROI models.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement, security, and legal reviews.
  • Partner with Customer Success during implementation.
  • Represent Haven at industry events.
  • Consistently exceed revenue targets.


What Success Looks Like:

Within your first year you will close multiple enterprise customers, become a trusted advisor to senior EHS leaders, contribute to Haven's go-to-market strategy, and help establish Haven as the leader in AI-powered industrial safety.


Required Experience Includes:
  • 7+ years of enterprise B2B software sales.
  • Success selling into Fortune 1000 organizations.
  • Experience leading complex multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.
  • Consistent history of exceeding quota.
  • Experience building executive relationships with EHS, Operations, Risk, or Operational Excellence leaders.
  • Strong consultative selling skills.
  • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience navigating procurement, security, and legal reviews.


Nice to Haves Include:
  • AI or advanced analytics solutions.
  • Utilities, Oil & Gas, Construction, Manufacturing, Mining, Chemicals, or other high-risk industries.
  • Early-stage or venture-backed SaaS companies.
  • Experience with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDICC or Challenger.
  • Direct experience selling EHS (Environmental, Health & Safety) software solutions.


\n

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://www.toptal.com/

Summary:

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer to design, build, and scale production-grade applications powered by generative AI. This role is focused on delivering real products, not just prototypes. The ideal candidate is a strong end-to-end builder who can make sound architectural decisions, integrate AI capabilities into usable systems, and balance fast delivery with long-term maintainability.

 

General Information:

This is a senior engineering role for someone who can own product development from architecture through deployment. The role requires strong full stack engineering fundamentals combined with hands-on experience integrating generative AI into production workflows. The right candidate understands how to build scalable backend services, intuitive frontends, and reliable AI-enabled features that serve real users. This person should bring strong product thinking, architectural judgment, and the ability to move independently from requirements to shipped solutions.

 

Tasks and deliverables:

  • Build end-to-end applications that incorporate generative AI capabilities into real user workflows
  • Develop scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations using modern engineering practices
  • Build responsive and maintainable frontend experiences using modern frameworks
  • Design modular system architectures that support scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability
  • Integrate LLMs and other AI tools into production applications with appropriate safeguards and monitoring
  • Optimize prompt flows, data pipelines, and system interactions for consistency and performance
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions and make strong implementation trade-offs
  • Own features from ideation through development, testing, deployment, and iteration

  • Hands-on experience integrating generative AI into production applications
  • Practical understanding of prompt engineering and AI system limitations, including failure modes and edge cases
  • Proven ability to design systems that scale beyond MVP and remain maintainable over time
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, and engineering best practices
  • Demonstrated experience shipping multiple production-grade products or platforms
  • Ability to combine traditional software engineering discipline with modern AI-driven workflows
  • Experience working independently with strong ownership and product mindset

 

Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to build impactful AI-powered products used in real production environments
  • High ownership across architecture, implementation, and delivery
  • Role suited for engineers who enjoy both product thinking and technical depth
  • Chance to shape scalable systems early and influence long-term engineering quality
  • Fast-paced environment with a strong emphasis on execution and practical outcomes
  • Meaningful work at the intersection of full stack engineering and applied AI

title: Senior Business Development Representative
description:
Headquarters: Austria, Linz
URL: https://otterly.ai/

Role Overview:

We're looking for an experienced New Business Development Representative who knows how to create opportunities, not just wait for them. 

This is a senior outbound role focused on building high-quality pipelines for our Account Executive team, whom you will work with closely on a daily basis.. You'll identify target accounts, engage decision-makers through multi-channel outreach, qualify opportunities, and book meetings with companies that have meaningful revenue potential.

You'll have the autonomy and freedom to test messaging, refine outbound strategies, and help shape how OtterlyAI goes to market. We care about quality over quantity—you'll focus on opening doors where OtterlyAI can create meaningful business impact, not simply hitting activity metrics.

Main Responsibilities:

1. Outbound Pipeline Generation: Build and manage outbound campaigns targeting marketing leaders, SEO teams, digital agencies, and enterprise organizations using LinkedIn, email, phone, and other creative outreach channels.
2. Account-Based Prospecting: Research and prioritize high-value accounts, identify key stakeholders, and develop personalized outreach that cuts through the noise.
3. Multi-Channel Outreach: Execute thoughtful cold and warm outreach across LinkedIn,
email, calling, and other channels to consistently generate qualified meetings.
4. Opportunity Qualification: Understand prospect pain points, qualify opportunities, and ensure every meeting handed to an Account Executive has a strong likelihood of progressing.
5. Pipeline Development: Own your pipeline targets by generating qualified opportunities that contribute directly to company growth and revenue.
6. Market Intelligence: Continuously gather insights from prospects, competitors, and the AI search landscape to improve messaging and identify new opportunities.
7. Process Improvement: Help optimize outbound playbooks, messaging, sequencing, and targeting as we continue to scale our sales motion.

Main requirements: 

Must Have:

  • 4+ years of outbound BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS ( MarTech, SEO, AI or Digital Marketing Solutions)

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding outbound meeting or pipeline targets

  • Experience prospecting into mid-market and enterprise organizations

  • Strong LinkedIn, email, and cold-calling skills

  • Experience using tools: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, or similar outbound tools

  • Fluent English (C1+)

  • Self-starter who enjoys ownership in a fast-growing remote scale-up

  • Available to collaborate across EU and US time zones.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Account-Based Sales (ABS) or Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Additional European languages

  • Experience building outbound campaigns from scratch.


What OtterlyAI Offers:

  • €4,000/month base (B2B contractor arrangement)

  • Uncapped commission based on qualified pipeline and closed business

  • Remote-first - work from anywhere in Europe

  • Flexible schedule with overlap across Europe and US timezones

  • Direct collaboration with founders and sales leadership

  • Opportunity to help define and scale OtterlyAI's outbound motion


Recruitment Process:

1.CV and brief selection: 
When submitting your CV, please also include a short note
of 3 - 4 paragraphs covering: Your most successful outbound campaign, The most creative way you've booked a difficult prospect, One insight about the future of AI search or SEO.

2.Video Call: If your CV and brief note aligns with our requirements, HR invites you for an initial video call.

3.Interview with the CRO: A deeper discussion about your experience, sales methodology, and previous achievements.

4.Challenge: Create an outreach strategy to high-tier leads for OtterlyAI prospects. 

5.Final Interview: Meet the founders and discuss how you would help OtterlyAI scale. 

6.Offer: If all goes well, we'll share an offer, and you can start your journey with OtterlyAI

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/otterly-ai-senior-business-development-representative

title: Brand Designer
description:
About Co-Star

Someone downloads CoâStar every 5 seconds.

In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app. Big Sean has rapped about us, Ariana Grande & Kevin Durant post screenshots to their IGs, and we've been App of the Day twice. We've been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of NYT Style. We have a global following, in 193 countries â missing just North Korea and Eritrea.

We don't pay for marketing â we designed the app to go viral, and it did.

Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years.

Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you're experiencing, and how you relate to other people â in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It's a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.

Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on. An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.

We're merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.

Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, CoâStar generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes â a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person's unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. CoâStar combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called "wildly beautiful."

We're a small, experienced team.

Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).

About The Brand Designer Role

We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what's now but what's next.

You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows.

What you'll do

  • Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches â from concept through finished assets
  • Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery
  • Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate
  • Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like
  • Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team

You might be a fit if

  • You're a senior IC â roughly 5â8 years in â with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital
  • Typography and composition are your first language
  • You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them
  • You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet
  • You work well remotely and independently

Nice to have

  • Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines)
  • Motion or illustration
  • You already make things with generative tools

Logistics

  • Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow
  • Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)

To apply

Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
About The Role

At Museum of Ice Cream, we exist to spark joy, create connection, and turn everyday moments into unforgettable experiences â while serving as the global champion of ice cream culture. From the brands and makers shaping the category to the communities that gather around it, MOIC sits at the center of a cultural movement built on nostalgia, creativity, and shared joy.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Creative PM to help bring structure, momentum, and timeline management to our creative projects. This role sits at the intersection of big imagination and meticulous execution â perfect for an experienced freelancer who knows how to hit the ground running and make an immediate impact.

What You'll Do

Creative Production & Project Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of creative projects across campaigns and marketing channels, from brief through to final delivery.
  • Build and maintain production timelines and project plans, keeping every stakeholder aligned on what's happening and when.
  • Translate creative concepts into actionable workstreams without losing the vision.
  • Support the SVP of Marketing & Brand Director with kick-off meetings, creative reviews, and production check-ins.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously across your contracted hours.

Process & Workflow Management

  • Champion creative process standards â ensuring briefs are clear, feedback loops are tight, and nothing goes into production without the right approvals.
  • Own and maintain Asana boards, workflows, and templates so the creative team stays focused on making, not chasing.
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and proactively recommend improvements.
  • Maintain version control and asset organisation across projects.
  • Support the Director, Marketing Strategy & Ops with timelines that feed into the broader Marketing team timelines.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Gather and clarify briefs from internal stakeholders before they reach the creatives.
  • Manage external vendor relationships â photographers, videographers, fabricators, and agencies â within the scope of your projects.

Budgets & Resources

  • Manage vendor estimates and POs as required.
  • Manage contract creative team budgets in support of the Director, Marketing Strategy & Ops

Reporting & Communication

  • Produce clear status updates and project recaps for the team and senior stakeholders.
  • Support in the maintenance of a shared creative calendar with visibility into upcoming campaigns and milestones.
  • Run post-mortems on completed projects and feed learnings back into process.

Contract Details

  • This is a temporary contractor role
  • The hourly pay is between $65/hr-$75/hr
  • Commitment: Approx. 20-30 hours per week
  • Duration: 3 months, with potential to extend
  • Location: Remote

Requirements

  • Calm under pressure, solutions-oriented, and highly organized.
  • Available for a consistent part-time commitment each week (hours to be agreed at contract stage).
  • Able to work independently as a contractor â you manage your own time and hit your deadlines.

title: Social Community Representative

The Social Community Representative is responsible for engaging with consumers, creators, and ambassadors across social media channels to build community, strengthen brand affinity, and support a positive customer experience. This remote, part-time role combines community management, creator support, social engagement, and content execution to help drive meaningful connections and brand growth.

Reporting to the DIGITAL COMMUNITIES' ASSOCIATE MANAGER, the SOCIAL COMMUNITY REPRESENTATIVE will support our collegiate team in the following areas and meet the job requirements below.

This is a remote, part-time position.

--

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to direct messages, comments, tagged content, and community interactions across social media platforms to support audience engagement and strengthen brand affinity.
  • Act as a trusted voice of the brand by reviewing and responding to consumer, creator, and ambassador inquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and attention to detail.
  • Foster positive brand sentiment through timely, thoughtful, and on-brand interactions across all social channels.
  • Support creator, ambassador, and community engagement by resharing stories, engaging with tagged content, and recognizing standout community members.
  • Amplify user-generated content (UGC) and spotlight exceptional creator and ambassador content through social features, community initiatives, and monthly reward or gift-code programs.

Identify and report recurring community themes, ambassador questions, consumer complaints, and engagement opportunities to help improve brand communications and customer experience.

  • Assist with content creation and execution across platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Threads, X, and other emerging social channels.
  • Contribute creative ideas, messaging concepts, and social-first content recommendations that align with brand voice and campaign objectives.
  • Encourage participation in community programs, ambassador challenges, competitions, seasonal campaigns, and engagement initiatives through proactive outreach.
  • Research social trends, creators, cultural moments, and emerging platforms to identify opportunities for community growth and engagement.

Requirements

  • Experience with excel.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent the brand voice professionally and enthusiastically.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, etc.) and current social trends.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and track many moving pieces at once.

  • A proactive, collaborative attitude and a passion for digital communities and creator culture.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
Role: Recruiter & People Operations Specialist

Base Salary: $95,000 - $110,000

We're looking for a People Operations Specialist to lead recruiting across Blackthorn while also supporting core people operations work. You'll own the full-cycle hiring process for open roles company-wide â from intake through offer â while partnering with the VP of People Operations on onboarding, HR systems, and day-to-day operational support. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role suited to someone who enjoys both the relationship-driven work of recruiting and the precision of operational execution.

What youâll do

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own the end-to-end recruiting process for roles across the company, from intake calls with hiring managers through offer negotiation.
  • Source, screen, and manage candidate pipelines using our ATS, partnering closely with hiring managers on role requirements and timelines.
  • Build and maintain a strong candidate experience at every stage of the process.
  • Track recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness) and report regularly to leadership.

People Operations Support



  • Support onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure a smooth experience for new hires and departing employees.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HRIS data.
  • Assist with benefits administration and respond to employee questions on policies and programs.
  • Help maintain compliance with employment law across the states (and potentially countries) where Blackthorn has employees.

Process & Systems Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to streamline recruiting and HR operational workflows.
  • Partner with the VP of People Operations on building scalable people processes as the company grows.

What we look for

  • 3â5+ years of experience in recruiting, with some HR or people operations exposure.
  • Proven ability to manage full-cycle recruiting independently, including sourcing, screening, and closing candidates.
  • Comfortable working with HRIS and ATS tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can build trust with hiring managers and candidates alike.
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in a remote-first, distributed team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for a B2B SaaS or Salesforce ecosystem company.
  • Familiarity with PEOs or multi-state employment compliance.

What we offer

  • An incredible team of smart and supportive people
  • A deep feeling of satisfaction and completion
  • Fully remote global team working from home
  • Stock options for every employee
  • Flexible work week
  • $400 office stipend
  • Maternity/Paternity leave
  • Student loan debt assistance
  • Pledge 1% - time off during the year for helping nonprofits
  • Health insurance contribution (if in the US)
  • Children's 529 college fund assistance (if in the US)

About Blackthorn

Blackthorn turns any organization's SalesforceÂ® CRM into event planning software powered by their connected data. We're a growing, distributed team with teammates across the globe, and we build Salesforce-native tools that help teams create events, engage attendees, process payments, and measure success â all without leaving their CRM. Our customers range from tiny nonprofits to global corporations, and our products are known for going live in hours, not weeks. We believe the best enterprise software should feel as intuitive as the apps you use every day.

Why our work matters

Most event management tools force teams to juggle disconnected systems, wrestle with flimsy integrations, and spend more time syncing data than planning events. We're building the alternative: a connected platform inside Salesforce that gives organizations richer analytics to prove event ROI, better attendee experiences through personalization and automation, and the flexibility to fit any workflow. Every feature we ship helps our customers spend less time on logistics and more time on the events themselves.

What the job will bring you

A deep level of satisfaction through ownership of your role. You'll get more autonomy than at other companies (our team has told us). Connection. Our team is tightly knit, assisted through occasional team meetups (as we're remote). Challenge. We're trying to move as quickly as possible. This is not for you if you want to sit back and chill. As Ray Dalio says about life, "Meaningful work and meaningful relationships" provide meaning to life. We aim to bring this.

While we are a remote-first culture, we are currently only able to accept applicants in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, and WI

title: Head of Operations
description:
At OpenTrack, we're tackling the fragmented data and workflows of the trillion dollar logistics industry. Using data collected in real time from hundreds of sources, we help customers keep their cargo moving efficiently, on time and at a cost savings.


The OpenTrack platform includes an AI logistics workflow builder, enterprise web application, API service, and customer white label portal which gives companies the ability to use best-in-industry freight visibility, performance metrics and predictive insights to fully automate logistics workflows.


Our customers are some of the most iconic brands and logistics companies in the world, and we have already transformed the way they work.


We are an international team (Nashville, Chicago, Europe) with a growing presence at our Nashville HQ.


We value autonomy, curiosity, and having a good time.  Weâre seeking a qualified candidate to join our team in the Head of Operations role.


Responsibilities
  • Serve as an extension of the CEO, owning decisions, communications, and workstreams on the CEO's behalf so they can focus on the highest-leverage priorities
  • Partner directly with the CEO and leadership team to drive strategic initiatives and ensure company priorities are executed effectively, often stepping in to lead directly when the CEO's bandwidth is needed elsewhere
  • Own cross-functional project management for high-impact initiatives end-to-end, from planning through execution, so the CEO is informed without being in the weeds
  • Triage and manage incoming requests, decisions, and open items directed at the CEO, filtering, delegating, and resolving the majority independently
  • Help define, document, and operationalize company-wide processes to improve efficiency and alignment, reducing the need for CEO involvement in recurring decisions
  • Act as a central hub for communication, ensuring clarity and coordination across teams and serving as the first point of contact so that only the most critical matters reach the CEO
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and proactively implement solutions, owning the fix rather than escalating
  • Drive accountability by tracking progress against company goals, KPIs, and strategic priorities, surfacing risks and course-correcting with minimal CEO involvement
  • Conduct analysis and research to inform decision-making on business strategy, partnerships, and growth opportunities, delivering clear recommendations rather than raw information
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and sounding board to the CEO on both strategic and operational matters, and proactively flag what the CEO needs to know before they have to ask
Qualifications
  • Proven experience (3â6 years) in a high-growth startup environment, consulting, operations, or strategy
  • Excellent written communication and organizational skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights
  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • High level of business judgment and ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, comfortable making decisions without full information
  • Demonstrated ability to act as a trusted representative of senior leadership, owning outcomes rather than just supporting them
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams and levels
  • Strategic thinker with a strong bias toward action and execution, removing problems rather than surfacing them
  • Detail-oriented, with a commitment to accuracy and operational excellence
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment and adapt quickly to evolving priorities

title: Data Analyst – AI Translation Quality
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: http://onthegosystems.com

At OnTheGoSystems, we're building AI systems that help people translate content across many languages. Our LLM team works with AI-generated translations, user edits, customer feedback, and quality data to continuously improve translation quality.

We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys solving open-ended problems, finding patterns in complex datasets, and turning data into practical recommendations. This is not a reporting role. You'll decide what to measure, investigate why things happen, and help the team make better decisions based on evidence.

What you'll do

You'll own analytical problems from start to finish.

For example, you may discover that users edit translations much more often for one language pair than another. Instead of simply reporting it, you'll investigate why. You'll form hypotheses, gather the data, test possible explanations, and recommend the next steps.

Your work will include:

  • Defining meaningful metrics for translation quality, AI performance, and user behavior.

  • Monitoring trends and identifying unusual patterns or quality issues.

  • Turning observations into structured investigations and testing multiple hypotheses.

  • Extracting and combining data from SQL databases, NoSQL databases, logs, APIs, and CSV exports.

  • Comparing results across language pairs, AI models, providers, customers, content types, traffic levels, and other dimensions.

  • Separating real signals from coincidence by validating findings with data.

  • Reviewing translation samples to confirm whether patterns represent genuine quality issues.

  • Investigating root causes and recommending practical improvements.

  • Evaluating multilingual AI output for meaning, terminology, tone, formality, grammar, pronouns, and consistency.

  • Using AI tools, dictionaries, and other resources to investigate languages you don't speak, while recognizing when expert linguistic input is needed.

  • Reviewing AI-generated analyses, identifying incorrect conclusions, and helping improve our automated evaluation systems.

  • Building repeatable reports, scripts, and monitoring processes.

  • Communicating findings clearly to developers, product managers, and linguists.

What we're looking for

  • Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • The ability to work independently and define what should be investigated.

  • Experience turning open-ended questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations.

  • A solid understanding of metrics, segmentation, distributions, correlations, and the difference between correlation and causation.

  • Experience writing SQL, Python, or similar scripts to collect, clean, and analyze data.

  • Experience working with multiple data sources, including databases, logs, APIs, and exported datasets.

  • Strong hands-on experience using AI tools while critically evaluating their output.

  • Fluent English plus at least one additional language (preferably European), with the ability to assess translation quality and explain language issues.

  • Clear written communication and the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical colleagues.

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Translation quality or localization.

  • Multilingual content.

  • Data visualization or business intelligence tools.

Why join us?

You'll work on real AI systems used by customers around the world and directly influence how we measure and improve machine translation quality.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring difficult questions, testing ideas, and discovering insights that aren't immediately obvious. You'll have the freedom to propose your own analyses and the responsibility to turn them into evidence-based recommendations.

What we offer

  • 100% remote position,

  • Body and Mind Movement program to fill you up with energy,

  • A computer budget to make your workplace better,

  • A Kindle device with access to our company Amazon account,

  • We respect national holidays in each country and want you to have a rest these days,

  • Great opportunity to progress and advance,

  • Collaborating with team members across the globe.

If you're excited by data, languages, AI, and solving complex problems, apply now, and we'd love to hear from you!

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-data-analyst-ai-translation-quality

title: Front-End WordPress Developer
description:
Headquarters: McLean, VA
URL: https://www.yokoco.com/

We’re seeking a Front-End Developer who wants to make the world a better place through clean code, thoughtful craftsmanship, and a genuine love of building great websites.

This isn’t just about turning designs into code, it’s about translating ideas into experiences, solving problems along the way, and taking pride in the details that make a site feel right. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys the craft of front-end development, cares about doing things the right way, and is always looking for a better, more efficient way to build.

Why work at Yoko Co?

  • Do good, better: We exclusively serve clients who make a positive impact on the world. This is your chance to build things that help create a better place for all of us.
  • 4-day flex week and lots of holidays. Mondays are flex days, meaning you’re free to take them off if you’re caught up on your work. Plus, we’re closed for nearly a full week at Thanksgiving (November), and two weeks at the end of the year, plus a bunch of other days, too.
  • High performance, no jerks. You’ll collaborate with good people who believe in doing great work. Best Place to Work (and that’s not just our opinion).
  • We’ve been named a Best Place to Work by the Inc. 5000 and Washington Business Journal. We value team members who are motivated by our mission and driven to make a positive impact.

If you have a passion for excellence, a growth mindset, and a commitment to collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll do:

As part of our development team, you’ll build websites and features from design references, turning Figma files into clean, maintainable, production-ready code. Our primary stack is built on Gutenberg block themes, so you’ll spend most of your time there, though you may also work on traditional WordPress themes and, occasionally, other page builders.

  • Build websites and site features from design references, using industry-standard code and best practices
  • Develop and maintain WordPress block themes using Gutenberg, templates, parts, patterns, and theme.json configuration
  • Work with traditional WordPress themes when needed, and occasionally with other page builder platforms
  • Write clean, well-structured HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Build or extend front-end functionality using React or similar component-based approaches when the project calls for it
  • Use Git and GitHub for version control, following team branching and code review conventions
  • Work within a continuous deployment workflow, ensuring changes move smoothly and safely from development to production
  • Troubleshoot cross-browser and cross-device issues to ensure consistent, polished results
  • Collaborate with designers, project managers, and strategists to bring projects to life
  • Look for new and more efficient ways to deliver our work, whether that’s through better tooling, reusable components, or refined processes
  • Contribute to internal documentation, component libraries, and knowledge sharing
  • Stay current with WordPress, Gutenberg, and front-end development trends and best practices

What we’re looking for:

We’re less concerned with rigid checklists and more interested in capable, thoughtful developers who care about quality and enjoy solving problems.  Strong candidates typically have:

  • Fluency in WordPress, with experience building both traditional themes and Gutenberg block themes
  • Comfort working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript Experience translating design references (Figma or similar) into accurate, responsive, production-ready code
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and collaborative development practices
  • Experience working within a continuous deployment or CI/CD pipeline
  • Experience working with tools like Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex
  • An eye for detail and a commitment to clean, maintainable code Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Fluent English for written and spoken communication
  • Bonus points:
    • Experience building custom Gutenberg blocks
    • Experience with React or similar component-based frameworks
    • Experience working in a multi-client or agency environment

You may not want to apply if…

  • You prefer 100% concrete specs handed to you with no ambiguity and no changes. We do our best to provide final, locked designs and specs, but things inevitably change as a project progresses
  • You’re not interested in learning or working within Gutenberg block themes
  • You’d rather work solo than collaborate with designers, PMs, and strategists
  • You’re reluctant to incorporate AI into your workflow

Front-end development here is a mix of code and configuration, and often requires curiosity, flexibility, and a willingness to find the most efficient path to a great result.

What you get:

You’ll get a flexible schedule, unlimited time off, a competitive salary, a profit share bonus (starting in your second year), the ability to work wherever you want, a personal development budget, and all US federal holidays and multiple weeks off at the end of the year to recharge. We’ll also offset your entire carbon footprint. If you’re in the US, we also offer health insurance, disability and life insurance, and 401(k) matching.

More about us:

We’re a group of people who are passionate about the work we do, the clients we serve, and improving our craft. We also care about each other — we don’t think of one another as coworkers or employees, but as fellow humans. From developers to designers, project managers to strategists, we bring out the best in each other.

We’ve been in business for over a decade, our whole team is remote, and we’ve been named a Best Place to Work by the Inc. 5000 and the Washington Business Journal.

To apply:

If you’re interested, fill out our application form. An actual human from our team looks at every submission. As much as we’d like to, we can’t promise that we’ll reply to every application.

P.S. We encourage you to include a video message!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/yoko-co-front-end-wordpress-developer

title: VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth
description:
About HealthCorps

HealthCorps is a national non-profit committed to improving lives by addressing health challenges in communities through innovative programming in education, leadership, and service learning. We empower teens to become change agents within their families, schools, and neighborhoods. Our program is grounded in the understanding that limited access to health education can lead to a lifetime of social, emotional, and physical challenges.

The Opportunity

HealthCorps is launching a new Growth & Strategic Partnerships Division, and the VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth will be its architect, engine, and external face. You'll hold a broad, high-impact portfolio: leading HealthCorps' national funder and strategic partnerships, driving development, grant management, and fundraising, shaping our brand and marketing, and growing our alumni, community, and hub partnership work. You won't do it alone. A national team, along with program managers across our hubs, will help you build and execute this vision.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will hold your own portfolio of partnerships, work closely with leadership to develop and execute strategies that meet HealthCorps' revenue and growth goals, and represent HealthCorps externally at donor meetings, funder convenings, and sector events. This is an ideal role for a mission-aligned leader who can prospect a health system executive and coach a marketing manager in the same week, someone energized by both the hunt and the build.

For-profit and private sector backgrounds are strongly welcomed. If you have driven revenue, built partnerships, and told a compelling brand story, in any sector, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

External Relationship Strategy, Cultivation & Maintenance (30%)

  • Serve as a key external relationship officer alongside the CEO, cultivating and stewarding relationships across health systems, corporate sponsors, school districts, foundations, and community organizations
  • Design and lead a comprehensive partnership strategy spanning grant, sponsor, and programmatic relationships that aligns funder priorities with organizational growth goals
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of new and emerging partnership opportunities, cultivating prospects from first touch through qualification
  • Steward existing partners to deepen loyalty, increase lifetime value, and drive renewals and upgrades
  • Track funding trends and shifting funder priorities to position HealthCorps ahead of major market shifts

Pitching, Proposals & Partner Stewardship (25%)

  • Own the full partnership sales cycle for mid-tier and emerging opportunities, from first outreach through close and activation
  • Develop pitches, proposals, and grant applications that translate HealthCorps' outcomes data into a compelling, fundable case for support
  • Partner with the CEO and leadership to identify, solicit, and close transformational sponsorships for the major annual fundraiser and national and hub-level programming
  • Demonstrate ongoing value to existing partners through exceptional stewardship that keeps them connected to our mission and measurable impact

Brand Strategy & Voice (20%)

  • Set strategic tone and direction for the HealthCorps brand across all external-facing channels and oversee the Marketing Manager in executing it across social media, website, newsletters, and press
  • Lead the design and execution of a brand and communications strategy that builds awareness and trust across funders, partners, and the broader public
  • Partner with program teams to translate research-validated impact data and stories into compelling, consistent external narratives
  • Develop partner-facing collateral â partnership decks, impact reports, and stakeholder communications â that reflect the quality of the organization
  • Represent HealthCorps at conferences, sector events, and media opportunities alongside the CEO and program leaders

Hub, Community & Alumni Partnerships (15%)

  • Build local advisory committees that connect HealthCorps to local civic, education, and philanthropic leaders, in partnership with the Alumni & Community Manager and Program Directors
  • Strengthen HealthCorps' presence in each market by partnering with local teams to plan events, cultivate partnerships, and raise the organization's visibility
  • Cultivate and engage HealthCorps' alumni as a strategic community, building a strong, active network and connecting alumni to advisory roles, volunteer opportunities, and local partnerships that extend our reach

Division Leadership & Team Management (10%)

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team: Senior Manager of Development, Marketing Manager, Director of Events (part-time), and Alumni & Community Manager
  • Serve as a player-coach who models the work while developing others, holding your own partnership portfolio while coaching the team toward revenue and relationship goals
  • Establish and monitor division KPIs across pipeline, revenue, and brand performance, reporting to the CEO and Board to ensure measurable ROI
  • Manage the division budget and contribute to organization-wide strategic planning as a member of the leadership team

Who You Are

You are a relationship-builder, a closer, and a brand thinker. The ideal candidate brings:

  • 7+years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, sales, or revenue-generating roles, with a demonstrated track record of closing and stewarding high-value relationships. Nonprofit, for-profit, and private sector backgrounds are all strongly welcomed
  • Experience holding your own portfolio while leading and developing a team; you are a player-coach who can model the work and develop others simultaneously
  • Proven pitching and presentation skills; you are comfortable in a boardroom, at a funder meeting, and in a pitch meeting, and you know how to read a room and close
  • Experience setting brand direction and overseeing marketing or communications functions, with the ability to translate complex program outcomes into compelling external narratives
  • Strong written communication skills: from partner proposals to grant narratives to impact reports, your writing moves people to act
  • Familiarity with health systems, corporate social responsibility, education, or youth-serving sectors; experience working with health systems or school districts is a strong plus
  • Comfort building and operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-growth environment where you may be creating systems and structures from scratch
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking. And a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking
  • A genuine belief in the power of near-peer mentorship and a passion for health equity and youth development

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in business, public health, communications, marketing, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience in business development, strategic partnerships, sales, or revenue leadership in any sector.
  • Experience managing direct reports and leading cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrated success closing and growing partnerships, accounts, or revenue relationships and managing a portfolio of accounts
  • Travel to HealthCorps hubs, partner sites, and sector events will be required

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, health systems, corporate social responsibility, or youth-serving organizations, nonprofit or for-profit
  • Track record of building revenue through client, sponsor, or partner relationships; experience with philanthropic fundraising is a plus but not required
  • Experience building advisory boards, local steering committees, or community engagement structures
  • Experience translating a commercial sales or business development skillset into a mission-driven environment
  • Master's degree or equivalent advanced training

Compensation & Benefits

This is a full time, exempt position, and you will be offered a comprehensive benefits package. Yearly compensation for the role depends on a number of factors, including candidates' qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and location.

Because we operate across multiple states, compensation is aligned with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including salary thresholds where applicable. Slight preference given to the candidate that live in one of our hub areas: Pittsburgh, PA, Philadelphia, PA, Cleveland, OH, Oklahoma City, OK, South Florida (Palm Beach/Miami), Houston, TX and Phoenix, AZ.

At HealthCorps, we believe our team members are our greatest asset. That's why full-time employees enjoy comprehensive benefits packages designed to support your health, financial security, and overall, well-being. Our offerings include

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) to relax, recharge, and take care of what matters most
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance to keep you and your family healthy
  • Life Insurance coverage for added piece of mind
  • A 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future
  • Additional ancillary benefits tailored to fit your lifestyle and needs

Plus, HealthCorps proudly recognizes and observes most federal holidays, giving you even more opportunities to rest and connect outside of work.

HealthCorps, Inc. Is an Equal Opportunity Employer. HealthCorps provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics, and in compliance with all state and federal law requirements.

HealthCorps, Inc. Complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

HealthCorps, Inc. Reserves the right to conduct background investigations and/or reference checks on all its potential employees. Your job offer is contingent upon a clearance of a background investigation and/or reference check.

Note: HealthCorps reserves the right to assign additional duties, as needed. All HealthCorps employees are encouraged to be flexible and responsive to changes in scope of duties.

title: Senior Director, Revenue Operations
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations

Role Description

Dropbox is seeking a Head of Revenue Operations to lead and scale the operational foundation of the company's global B2B go-to-market organization. This role will be responsible for driving operational excellence across the revenue engine, enabling predictable, efficient growth across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments. This role will also oversee Marketing Operations, ensuring alignment between demand generation, pipeline creation, and revenue outcomes across the full customer lifecycle. This leader will own revenue planning, forecasting, revenue operations, incentives, systems, analytics, and GTM infrastructure. Partnering closely with Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Customer leadership, this role will play a critical role in strengthening execution rigor, improving forecast accuracy, and enabling Dropbox to scale across products, regions, and sales motions, including product-led, sales-assisted, and enterprise.

Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously improve Dropbox's end-to-end revenue operating model, including segmentation, account coverage, territory design, role clarity, and cross-functional handoffs across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support
  • Lead annual and quarterly revenue planning processes, including bookings targets, quota setting, capacity planning, territory design, and ramp assumptions
  • Establish forecasting rigor, pipeline management processes, inspection cadences, and performance management standards that improve visibility and predictability across the business
  • Define, track, and operationalize core revenue and GTM KPIs (e.g., pipeline coverage, win rates, ACV, sales cycle, productivity, CAC, velocity, retention, and expansion), identifying performance gaps and driving operational improvements
  • Lead revenue operations across the customer lifecycle, from lead routing and opportunity management through renewal and expansion, ensuring scalable processes, governance, and execution excellence
  • Partner with Data Science on analytical support and insights, experimentation and cadence for biz performance updates
  • Partner with Finance on revenue planning, pricing operations, discounting frameworks, deal governance, sales compensation, and incentive design to support growth and operational discipline
  • Partner with Customer Success and Support leadership to improve retention, renewal, and expansion outcomes through operational insights, reporting, and process optimization
  • Enable GTM readiness and operational execution for new product launches, packaging changes, pricing updates, and growth initiatives
  • Deliver executive-level reporting, business reviews, and performance insights that support decision-making across revenue leadership
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Revenue Operations organization, driving operational excellence, scalable processes, and the adoption of AI-enabled solutions that improve productivity and business performance

Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations, Finance, or related functions within a scaled SaaS or product-led growth company
  • Proven experience leading revenue operations for multi-segment B2B organizations across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise customer segments
  • Deep expertise in forecasting, revenue planning, territory design, quota management, sales productivity, incentive compensation, and pipeline management
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, revenue motions, and key operational drivers across acquisition, expansion, and retention
  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational challenges and implement scalable, data-driven solutions that improve business performance
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Customer organizations
  • Experience supporting organizations through significant growth and GTM evolution, including PLG, sales-assisted, and enterprise motions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with extensive experience leveraging data to drive operational and business decisions
  • Track record of building, developing, and leading high-performing revenue operations teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record implementing AI-enabled revenue solutions that deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, productivity, and business outcomes
  • Demonstrated experience owning and scaling GTM technology ecosystems, with deep expertise in Salesforce and related revenue platforms

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

US Zone 1

This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2$267,000—$361,200 USDUS Zone 3$237,300—$321,100 USD
